dedupe_keys.name: projected freshwater needs of the energy sector in the european union and the uk jrc

description: This data set gives projections of the freshwater needs of the energy sector, covering primary energy supply and transformation in power plants and oil refineries, in the European Union and the United Kingdom from 2015 to 2050 in five-year steps. It was produced by Ignacio Hidalgo González, Hrvoje Medarac and Davide Magagna of the European Commission Joint Research Centre, with the JRC technical report EUR 30266 EN of 2020. Projections combine water withdrawal and consumption factors for energy technologies with six energy scenarios. Coverage is EU countries and the UK at national and NUTS2 level. The data are one XLSX workbook of about 18 MB on Zenodo (June 2020) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, replacing an earlier version. Caveats: results depend on the six scenarios and on generic water factors per technology, and the data predate recent energy policy changes. Simulation uses are water-energy interdependency studies and adaptation planning for thermal power plant cooling under drought. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
